data.exact_reserve_text: The P/L excess of loss account saw a negative gross incurred claims movement of GBP 4.0m ... This prompted the ultimate gross claims position to move out by GBP 17.0m.

prior_year_events.event_name: Prior years loss information manifesting in late 2014
prior_year_events.impact_description: Ultimate gross claims position moved out by GBP 17.0m due to prior years loss information manifesting in Q3/Q4 2014

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded adverse prior-year reserve development in 2014 with an increase in gross claims outstanding of approximately GBP 17.0m. The movement was driven by loss information on prior years that manifested in the second half of 2014 and resulted in an adverse movement (strengthening) of reserves, with reinsurance mitigating some but not all of the impact. The development affected the syndicate's aggregate portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: negative gross incurred claims movement of GBP 4.0m
This prompted the ultimate gross claims position to move out by GBP 17.0m
numerous and complex, but largely arise from loss information on prior years manifesting itself in Q3 and Q4 of 2014 calendar year
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet prior-year column but the scanned images made exact line-labels partially unclear. Prior-year development (gross GBP 17.0m) was taken from explicit narrative text; movement figures in P&L tables exist (net figures) but were not used. Detailed regulatory segmental premium mix could not be reliably extracted from images, so gross_premium_mix left empty. Some numeric values inferred from partially legible tables; confidence scores shown accordingly.
